name: Barilla Gluten-Free Penne Pasta (Corn & Rice Blend, Cooked Tender)
whyItWorks: Formulated with non-GMO white corn, yellow corn, and white rice flour. Naturally free of inflammatory wheat gluten, virtually free of insoluble fiber (1g per serving), and cooks up smooth and tender.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil in salted water for 10–11 minutes until fully tender, past the tough al dente stage. Toss with olive oil, melted ghee, or mild seedless marinara.
